descriptions.zh: 我们找到了一长串前§Y巴奥§!殖民地推断位置的坐标，应该着手深入调查。
descriptions.en: We have found a list of coordinates representing the supposed location of a former §YBaol§! colony. We should investigate further.

titles.zh: 前巴奥殖民地调查 II

descriptions.zh: 我们从古代古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前§Y巴奥§!殖民地的坐标，应该对该遗址进行深入调查。
descriptions.en: The coordinates of another former §YBaol§! colony have been extracted from an ancient Grunur datacrystal. We should investigate the site further.

titles.zh: 前巴奥殖民地调查 III

descriptions.zh: 我们从古代古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前§Y巴奥§!殖民地的坐标，应该对该遗址进行深入调查。
descriptions.en: The coordinates of another former §YBaol§! colony have been extracted from an ancient Grunur datacrystal. We should investigate the site further.

descriptions.zh: 我们的传感器收到了似乎包含古茹努尔数字签名的求救信号。在这一迄今未被发现的恒星系里，这个早已消失的物种还有可能留下些什么呢？
descriptions.en: Our sensors have picked up what appears to be a distress signal bearing Grunur datalogical signatures. What could possibly remain of this long lost species, in this hitherto-undiscovered star system?

titles.en: Develop A Cure For The Ferrophage

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的C.A.R.E交互界面请求我们帮助开发一种治疗以金属为食的病毒的方法，这种病毒已经困扰了它数千年。

如何针对这种古老的外星生化病毒的开发解毒剂，使这里的人工智能免受荼毒，还有待研究。
descriptions.en:
The C.A.R.E Interactive Interface on [Root.GetName] has asked for our assistance in developing a cure for the metal-eating virus that has plagued it for thousands of years.

How one might develop an antidote for an ancient biological alien virus inflicting an artificial intelligence remains to be seen.

titles.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

descriptions.zh: 我们的科学官将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求伊拉斯人的知识并为我们所用。
descriptions.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Irassians to our own.

titles.zh: 进一步研究沃陶姆的秘密
titles.en: Delve Deeper into the Secrets of the Vultaum

descriptions.zh:
我们不能仅仅因为害怕可能的后果就放弃追寻真相。沃陶姆发现的某些东西撕碎了他们的现实。

我们无所畏惧。
descriptions.en:
We cannot stop searching for the truth just because the implications may be disturbing. The Vultaum found something that shattered their reality.

We are unafraid.

descriptions.zh: 尽管伟大先驱无疑是一艘强力舰船，它并没有发挥出全部潜力。缺少维护，轻微损伤累积和我们并不完全了解该舰这一简单事实等因素一并作用，损害了舰船的战斗能力。只有一次对舰船系统的全面整修和在此过程中我们获得的对此舰船的完整理解可以使其恢复到完好的运行状态。
descriptions.en: While the Grand Herald is undoubtedly a powerful ship, it is not operating at its full potential. A combination of lack of maintenance, cumulative minor damages, and the simple fact that we don't fully understand it all degrade its combat capabilities. Only a full overhaul of its systems and the resulting complete understanding of this ship will restore it to fully operational status.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经从一艘外星飞船的残骸中找到了这些日志，希望它们能告诉我们一些关于这艘飞船最后时刻的事情。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]指出这些日志涉及的信息面相当广泛，可能需要一段时间来翻译。
descriptions.en: We have recovered the logs from the wreckage of an alien spacecraft in the hopes that they will tell us something of its final moments. Science officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has flagged that they are quite extensive and may take a while to translate.

descriptions.zh: 哨兵厚实的鳞状外层经证实无法被普通工具穿透，考古学家需要工程部门的协助才能有所进展。
descriptions.en: The Sentinels' thick, scale-plated outer layer has proven impenetrable with ordinary tools and the archaeologists need assistance from the engineering department to proceed further.

descriptions.zh: 在一座先前的哨兵的底座下隐藏着一块有复杂图样的圆形石板。我们相信这可能是通向一处地下复合建筑体的入口。
descriptions.en: Previously hidden below the base of one of the Sentinels is an intricately patterned circular slate. We believe it may be the entrance to an underground complex.

descriptions.zh: 我们重建的“永恒”将使群众们获得更为廉价的娱乐和休闲方式，外星人们也能永远享受他们的数字乐园。
descriptions.en: A reconstruction of the Evermore will give the masses access to cheap entertainment and relaxation, leaving the aliens to enjoy their digital paradise eternally.

descriptions.zh: 我们可不能让自己受到永远挣欢乐豆的处罚。我们必须重新设定“永恒”，以便使之更好地符合我们对有意义活动的理解。
descriptions.en: We cannot sentence our own to an eternity spent counting legumes. We must repurpose the Evermore to better fit our idea of a meaningful activity.

descriptions.zh: §Y裂爪龙§!，老鼠们的噩梦，誊录仪的收藏者，现在只留下了一具毫无生机的躯壳，静静地围着恒星公转。我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]设想，既然裂爪龙活着的时候能够保护这台誊录仪，那她在死后应该也能效力于誊录仪的新主人。
descriptions.en: The §YShard§!, rat-terror, Rubricator-keeper, and now dead husk, orbits around the local star. Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] posit that, as the great beast guarded the Rubricator in life, so should it serve the Rubricator's new masters in death.

descriptions.zh:
年迈的巨龙被另一个国家消灭了，大概往好了说也只是一厢情愿，但还是希望她最珍贵的财产，誊录仪，会被忽视掉并留在原处。

文物另说，龙的遗体本身就能算是个财宝库。
descriptions.en:
With the old dragon's demise at the hands of another, it is perhaps wishful thinking at best that her most treasured possession, the Rubricator, would have been overlooked and left behind.

Artifacts aside, a dragon's remains alone could be a treasure trove.
